# Contributing

1. Read the [glossary](../docs/glossary/README.md): skills follow meaning.
2. Branch from `development` (here we work). Never commit to `master`.
3. This repository holds skills, manifests and docs, no code. A behaviour BOS
   needs goes to the core ([blacksmith-organization-system](https://github.com/Sarverott/blacksmith-organization-system));
   an idea not built yet goes to [docs/ideas](../docs/ideas/README.md).
4. Commits are conventional commits (`type(scope): subject`).
5. Open a pull request into `revision`. A maintainer (or someone they
   authorize) approves; self-approval only after automated checks, and a second
   pair of eyes is always healthier.
6. From there: `testing` → `releasing` → `master` through a pull request.
   See [branch movement procedures](../docs/infographics/branch-movement-procedures.md).

Mark unknowns [`TODO`] and interpretations *(assumed)*; don't invent meanings.
